SERVICE_HEADLINE: From a car park scrape to a serious repair
TAGLINE: A Van Nuys body shop handling everything from a scuffed bumper to major collision work, including complete paint jobs.
HOURS: Mon-Thu 9am-5pm · Fri 9am-1pm · Closed Saturday and Sunday
SERVICES_INTRO: Dents, scratches, side scrapes, bumpers, hoods, trunks, doors, fenders and quarter panels.
SERVICE_1_BODY: Large accidents and small ones, with the structural work done before the cosmetic work.
SERVICE_2_BODY: The everyday damage that makes a good car look tired, put right quickly.
SERVICE_3_BODY: Full respray or a single panel matched to the rest of the car.
WHY_INTRO: There are other shops within a few minutes of here. This is what a customer actually notices.
WHY_1_BODY: The quote comes before the work, and nothing gets done without you agreeing to it.
WHY_2_BODY: A person picks up during opening hours, and a missed call gets returned the same day.
WHY_3_BODY: Whatever came off the car is there to look at if you want to see it.
CONTACT_INTRO: Call for anything urgent. For a quote or a booking the form reaches the desk directly.
